_about: THE FRONT-DOOR BENCHMARK (2026-10-07). Natural-language claims, as a person types them at Bring anything, each with its truth. tools/frontdoor.py runs every one through the auditor funnel (audit.extract -> verify_derivation) and measures REACH (did any extractor hand it to a verifier), CORRECTNESS on what was reached, FALSE POSITIVES (a false claim CONFIRMED - must be 0) and FALSE NEGATIVES (a true claim MISMATCHED). Pairs: each true claim has a false twin, so reach is never bought with credulity. A claim that is not reached is an honest miss, named, never a verdict. The floor ratchets: once a claim is reached and correct it must stay so. FOUND (2026-10-07): a claim no verifier reaches but the keeping's sourced tables hold (factfind: half-lives, normal boiling points, atomic weights) is counted in its own column - found / found_correct / found_false_positives (reported) - never in reach, correct or the floor.
